text:
Cara (CS): quick heads-up — we detected a validation checksum mismatch in the onboarding ingest pipeline that delayed final verification for a set of customers overnight. about 13 tenants impacted; 4 flagged as high-touch/near-launch. incident doc here: https://redwood.share/inc/2412345678 :warning:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-6120 | Severity: P2 | Impact: onboarding validation delays for ~13 tenants | Eng oncall paged

Luis (Onboard): saw partial manifests stuck in validation. 4 are on a fast-track migration (2 enterprise, 2 mid-market); could be renewal risk if timelines slip.

Cara (CS): comms proposal: 1) immediate short status to impacted contacts; 2) offer prioritized validation sessions + 72 hours free credits for the 4 fast-track tenants; 3) schedule enablement clinics for anyone who wants help finishing. Need AM and legal sign-off.

Mina (Eng): root cause summary: a downstream library change slightly altered checksum calc for rare file ordering; we rolled a hotfix at 02:05 UTC and reprocessed backlog. we'll provide a 2-sentence RCA we can paste into customer email.

Pri (AM): please add me to the 4 fast-track accounts. if any indicate timeline risk, I’ll work concessions. 72h credits ok. Also recommend offering an executive sync for the 2 enterprise ones.

Omar (Legal): wording note: avoid any phrasing that suggests data loss. fine to offer credits and sessions. I’ll review the template within the hour.

Cara (CS): draft status copy (short):

"Hi <Name>,

We experienced a verification delay during parts of last nights onboarding ingest which affected final validation for some customers. The issue is resolved and we have reprocessed your files. We're sorry for any inconvenience. To help, we'd like to offer a prioritized validation session and 72 hours of account credits; if you'd like faster assistance, reply and we'll schedule immediately.

Cara, Customer Success"

Mina (Eng): suggested RCA blurb: "Cause: a library update changed checksum ordering for a small set of manifests; Fix: hotfix deployed and backlog reprocessed; Impact window: 2026-06-09 00:4002:05 UTC; Mitigations: pin checksum lib and added end-to-end validation checks."

Luis (Onboard): two practical asks: 1) can eng provide a short troubleshooting checklist for calls? e.g. `verify-manifest -> re-run-validate -> confirm pass_count == expected` 2) can RevOps surface local contacts so we can schedule in business hours?

Mina (Eng): added checklist to the incident doc: `verify-manifest -> trigger-validate -> confirm pass_count == expected_count`

Ping (RevOps): I'll pull timezones and localized contact lists for the impacted tenants and add calendar-links for scheduling.

Cara (CS): action items:
- send short status email to all impacted within 90 mins (owner: Cara)
- schedule prioritized validation sessions for the 4 fast-track tenants (owner: Luis)
- AM outreach + exec sync for enterprise tenants (owner: Pri)
- legal review of copy (owner: Omar)
- eng to paste RCA blurb and checklist (owner: Mina)
- RevOps to localize sends and provide calendar links (owner: Ping)

Pri (AM): also suggest offering a post-session micro-survey: "Did the session resolve your validation issue? (yes/no)" + "On a scale of 1-5 how confident are you in your launch timeline?" flag <=3 for immediate follow-up.

Cara (CS): good call. we'll include the survey link in the post-session email and route <=3 to Pri for concessions.

Mina (Eng): I'll publish the brief postmortem and mitigation list in 48 hours and tag this incident for follow-up.

Omar (Legal): approved phrasing tweak: replace "reprocessed your files" with "completed a targeted reprocessing". Otherwise good.

Cara (CS): thanks team — I'll post the outbound copy once legal signs off and start outreach. I'll update here after the first 6 touchpoints. :white_check_mark:
